title: Dashboard loads operational overview content
description: This verifies that an analyst can open the dashboard and review the key operational widgets rendered from mock data.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboards
Verify dashboard metric cards are displayed
Verify an activity chart is displayed
Verify recent jobs and notifications are displayed

title: Sync jobs page shows list and controls
description: This verifies that an operations user can open the sync jobs page and see the list, filters, pagination, and job detail access points.

steps.description: Navigate to /sync-jobs
Verify the sync jobs list is displayed
Verify filtering controls are displayed
Verify pagination controls are displayed
Verify job detail access is available

title: Sign in form shows required controls
description: This verifies that a guest can open the sign-in screen and see the controls needed to start signing in.

steps.description: Navigate to /sign-in
Verify the email or username input is visible
Verify the password input is visible
Verify the login action is available

title: Sync job details open from the list
description: This verifies that a user can open a sync job from the list and inspect its detail view.

steps.description: Navigate to /sync-jobs
Open a job from the list
Verify the job detail drawer is displayed
Verify the selected job details are displayed

title: Sync jobs filter narrows the visible jobs
description: This verifies that applying a filter changes the visible sync jobs list in a way the user can observe.

steps.description: Navigate to /sync-jobs
Select a job filter value
Verify the visible jobs list updates to reflect the filter
Verify the filtered results remain on the sync jobs page

title: Empty sign-in submission shows validation
description: This verifies that submitting the sign-in form without credentials produces UI validation feedback and does not leave the sign-in screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /sign-in
Click the login action
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the user remains on the sign-in page

title: Dashboard displays populated widgets
description: This verifies that the dashboard presents meaningful metric and trend content rather than an empty or broken layout.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboards
Verify dashboard metric cards are displayed
Verify dashboard trend data is displayed
Verify operational activity content is displayed

title: Sync jobs pagination moves through results
description: This verifies that a user can browse beyond the first page of sync jobs and see a different set of results.

steps.description: Navigate to /sync-jobs
Advance to the next page of results
Verify a different set of jobs is displayed
Verify pagination indicates the page change

title: Information pages render from app navigation
description: This verifies that a user can move through the informational pages and see each route's expected content.

steps.description: Navigate to /monitoring
Verify monitoring content is displayed
Click the link to the data mapping page
Verify data mapping content is displayed
Click the link to the settings page
Verify settings content is displayed

title: Review settings information
description: A guest user can open the settings page and review the settings options shown there.

steps.description: Navigate to /settings
Verify settings options are displayed

title: Review data mapping information
description: A guest user can open the data mapping page and review the data mapping information shown there.

steps.description: Navigate to /data-mapping
Verify data mapping information is displayed

title: Review monitoring information
description: A guest user can open the monitoring page and review the monitoring information shown there.

steps.description: Navigate to /monitoring
Verify monitoring information is displayed

title: Sync job details can be closed and reopened
description: This verifies that a user can dismiss a job detail view and open another job detail again without losing list navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to /sync-jobs
Open a job from the list
Close the job detail drawer
Open a job from the list again
Verify the job detail drawer is displayed again
Verify the job details are displayed
